Diagnosis.submission: The user-service Kubernetes Service has no endpoints due to a selector/label mismatch. Its selector is `current_service_name=user-service,service=user-service`, but no pod in the social-network namespace carries the `current_service_name` label (all other services select only on `service=<name>`). Since the Service matches no pods, kube-proxy rejects traffic to user-service ClusterIP 10.96.46.35:9090 with Connection refused, even though the user-service pod itself is healthy and listening (direct TCP to pod IP 10.244.110.156:9090 succeeds). This breaks its callers: compose-post-service logs `TSocket::open() connect() <Host: user-service Port: 9090>: Connection refused`, and nginx-thrift cascades into `ComposePost(): compost_post failure: connect() failed: Connection refused` HTTP 500 errors, failing the wrk2 compose-post workload. Root cause: the extra `current_service_name: user-service` selector entry on the user-service Service (endpoint-less service), which must be removed or matched by pod labels.
